name: message_sanitization_repair_tool_call_arguments
notes: Malformed tool_call argument JSON repair ladder. PORT FIX: src/agent/message_sanitization_ports.c::msz_repair_tool_call_arguments was a thin escape-only stub diverging from LIVE agent/message_sanitization.py::_repair_tool_call_arguments; rewritten as the full ladder (strip -> None -> strict parse/reserialise -> trailing-comma strip -> close unclosed structures -> bounded excess-closer trim loop -> final parse -> control-char escape pass -> '{}' fallback) with libjson as the parse oracle. Harness carries a traced copy of that port; the real ports file is linked via extra_src. Known excluded divergence classes (not exercised by inputs): literal control chars inside strings (Python pass-0 uses json.loads(strict=False) so it repairs them early; libjson rejects them), NaN/Infinity literals (Python accepts, libjson rejects), and brace/bracket characters inside string values (Python's count-based closer accounting is string-blind, the port tracks strings).
